reference: Unchanged original project portrait atlas, not historical photographic likeness

geometry.validation: Actual skin/eye ray intersections, independent outer-lip surface rays and mesh bounds; does not measure likeness or PBR appearance

physicalMouthPropProbe.method: Independent actual indexed skin ray; world-space cup/bite marker and exact nearest triangle on the actual vessel body/full shoulder mesh

costumeAudit.scope: Finite runtime mesh attributes, index bounds and world transforms across all cast/poses. Visual contact checked separately.

render_basis.renderer: Blender 4.5.15 Cycles, neutral studio setup; no WebGL capture

observations.ryo: Folded cap contacts the hair knot and keeps forehead and ears clear in all four views; face and side locks remain readable.
observations.zo: Waved nape strands arise behind the ear, trace the neck, and avoid skin clipping; long beard joins cheek and chin and tapers continuously.
observations.kai: Cup lip visually contacts the mouth in strict side and three-quarter views; both hands grip/support the vessel and the crown and armor do not clip.

kai_drink_contact.method: Post-update world-space distance between cup drinkContact marker and anatomical mouth anchor; cup scale applied once.

known_limits: Blender renders inspect exported geometry and materials, not browser WebGL output.
Skin appears smoother and paler than the textured portrait atlas under neutral light, especially Ryo's cheeks and lips.
Ryo's scholar cap reads geometrically crisp and gray under neutral lighting versus the softer black cloth in the portrait atlas.
Ryo's white inner collar forms angular exposed strips below the neck in front and three-quarter views.
Zo's loose white nape strands are still sparse in side view compared with the atlas portrait.

limits: Actual WebGL display and device frame rate were not verified: local browser use is disabled in Work settings.
CPU Lambert previews and neutral Blender Cycles renders are distinct from game WebGL lighting.
Stylized mesh grooms and sculpted skin do not reproduce portrait microhair, photographic pores or cloth simulation.
Head data grows from about 16MB to 29.6MB; deferred loading and low LOD are retained, but current slow-network startup was not timed.
